trainable: CNN only; BiLSTM and classifier frozen throughout; BN running statistics frozen
distillation: Mean over true time steps KL(frozen E1 raw replay || student replay with branch actual preprocessing), T=1
normalization_scope: Each approach applies its actual preprocessing to BOTH handwritten and synthetic inference/replay. No handwriting-oracle routing.
effective_batch: one original, at most one same-parent augmentation, two synthetic replay; equal domain loss and inverse-original-count writer weights
selection: All gates versus matching frozen pipeline and absolute synthetic gates versus A; minimum 3 fewer edits, no-whitespace/exact/source nonworsening. Rank eligible by CER, no-whitespace CER, negative exact. Frozen E1 fallback. Secondary augmented validation never selects.
uncertainty: One validation writer/two sources. Sourcewise/leave-one-source-out sensitivity only; no IID-tier CI or writer-population CI.
